newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST - Tokyo Nov CPI seen rising 0.1 yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Tokyo Nov CPI seen rising 0.1 yr/yr.

text.p: Consumer prices in Tokyo are expected to show a rise of 0.1 percent year-on-year in November after a fall of 0.1 percent in October, according to forecasts of economic institutions polled by Reuters.

Consumer prices throughout the country in October are expected to increase by 0.2 percent year-on-year in October, according to an average of the forecasts. Prices were unchanged in September from a year ago.
"Prices of durable goods continue to decline, but there are signs that overall consumer prices have stopped falling," said an economist at DKB Research Institute.
